propositions: Negative caplog assertions (assert not ...) pass vacuously when zero records are captured, masking 100% coverage loss as green test results
Logger propagation disabled or level raised process-globally during test execution prevents later tests from capturing rebar logs, causing silent void assertions and order-dependent flakiness
Five negative caplog assertions across the test suite are susceptible to void coverage via the propagation and level vectors, undetectable from green run output alone

An autouse fixture guard must detect and fail on logger propagation=False and contain (snapshot/restore) level mutations to make unreachable assertions fail loudly at the source rather than silently passing
Two distinct poisoning mechanisms exist: configure_logging() disables propagate and install_stderr_handler() raises the shared rebar logger level, both process-global and never restored
